title: Render complete trajectory and spatial figure packages
description: Validate analysis-specific required plot inventories and render final-size editable PDF/SVG plus 600-dpi TIFF figure packages for trajectory topology, velocity, fate mapping, RegVelo, spatial platform QC, spatial statistics, deconvolution, domains, communication, image analysis and multislice 3D reconstruction using a single versioned R graphic contract.
questions: Does this trajectory or spatial analysis have a complete, traceable and journal-sized figure inventory with consistent typography, strokes, color, legends and source data?
preconditions: Analysis type and target journal profile are declared; every panel has source data, units, sample identity and statistical meaning; final canvas size is chosen before rendering.
assumptions: Source tables already passed their analysis-specific quality gates; the figure renderer does not repair or reinterpret biological results.

quality_gates.description: Require every analysis-specific mandatory plot ID or explicitly mark the package incomplete; optional plots remain data-driven.
Use 5-7 pt final-size typography, at least 0.5 pt strokes, outside legends, colorblind-safe encodings, editable PDF/SVG and 600-dpi TIFF.
Bind each panel to reloaded source tables, claim, units, sample/experimental unit, statistics and cryptographic digests.

limitations: The generic renderer supplies a validated visual grammar; analysis-specific adapters must format source tables and may add official method-native plot layers. A complete-looking figure cannot rescue invalid upstream analysis.

dependencies.name: r
dependencies.purpose: Render all formal trajectory and spatial figure outputs with one R backend.

code_templates.purpose: Export the versioned analysis-specific figure inventory and visual tokens.
Validate panel source data and render PDF/SVG/TIFF at final publication size.

template_sections.purpose: Select the exact required plot inventory for the analysis.
required_logic: Export the versioned profile from visualization.py.
Map every required panel ID to a reloaded source table, claim, units and statistical meaning.
Block complete status when any mandatory panel is missing.

template_sections.purpose: Render consistent final-size vector and raster outputs.
required_logic: Use R/ggplot2 with global typography, stroke, color, axes and legend tokens.
Export individual panels and aggregate editable PDF/SVG plus 600-dpi TIFF.
Reload files, validate dimensions/size and record every input/output digest.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Choose exactly one registered trajectory or spatial profile; required plots cannot be removed for aesthetics.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Fail complete-profile status if a required ID has no source table; record optional omissions.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Set final canvas before rendering, keep 5-7 pt text and at least 0.5 pt strokes, and place legends outside panels.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Inspect PDF/SVG text editability, TIFF dpi, clipping, overlap, category order and colorblind accessibility.

preflight_checks: Inspect every upstream object/table and map claims, units, sample identity, statistical tests and panel IDs.
Detect exact R, ggplot2, patchwork, svglite, ragg, jsonlite and digest versions.
postflight_checks: Reload individual and aggregate PDF/SVG/TIFF outputs and verify file size, dimensions, fonts, labels, legends, clipping and digest manifest.
Confirm all required plots are present and visual encodings agree across comparable panels.
forbidden_actions: Use the R backend for formal plotting; do not silently switch to Python plotting.

Do not fabricate missing panels or source data, hide failed/discordant results, place legends over data, use text below 5 pt or strokes below 0.5 pt, alter comparable axes, or claim a profile complete when required panels are absent.
